_doc: Specs for tools/assets/New-MachineSound.ps1. One row per working-sound loop. id = the sound event path under the grindless namespace and the file name in assets/grindless/sounds/. recipeType is documentation only (the wiring lives in startup_scripts/grindless/sounds.js and tools/analysis/test/sounds.test.mjs keeps both in step). duration in seconds (0.5-30, ElevenLabs limit), volume and attenuation (blocks, default 16) go into sounds.json, quality is the libvorbis -q (budget: each .ogg at most 100 KB).

sounds.prompt: Seamless looping ambience of a radio observatory control room: a low steady electronic hum, soft slow data-processing pings and faint cooling fans, calm and scientific, no voices, no music
Seamless looping industrial sound of a huge chemical plant: bubbling reactors, steady pump drone, hissing steam vents and a deep pipe rumble, heavy machinery, no voices, no music
Seamless looping sound of a fusion plasma caster: a deep resonant energy hum rising and falling, crackling electric arcs, a faint magnetic whine, sci-fi reactor, no voices, no music
